scenario: 社区搜索 (UGC 短文本搜索): 用户在社区平台搜索帖子、问答、评论等 UGC 内容。 核心指标是搜索相关性 (nDCG) 和点击率 (CTR)。 关注：语义匹配、query 理解、短文本召回、排序模型、LLM 在搜索中的应用。

papers.title: Procedural Graphs: Self-Evolving Execution Structures for LLM Agents
papers.authors: Yuxing Lu, Yicheng Chen, Shanchan Wu, Sercan \"{O}. Ar{\i}k
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.09153v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as agents that plan over long horizons and act through external tools. Most agents select actions through unconstrained generation over an accumulating history, leaving implicit the procedural knowledge of what to do, in what order, and under which conditions. As trajectories lengthen, agents can lose track of their objectives, invoke tools out of order, and repeat unproductive actions. We introduce the Procedural Graph: just as a knowledge graph organizes factual knowledge into (entity, relation, entity) triplets for what-is questions, a Procedural Graph organizes procedural knowledge into (procedure, relation, procedure) triplets for what-to-do questions. At each decision step, the framework localizes the agent's active node, and a guidance model translates the surrounding subgraph into step-level situational guidance that biases the solver's next action without dictating it. The graph
papers.summary: 论文把智能体的操作顺序与执行条件表示为过程图，每步只读取当前节点附近的子图，再根据成功与失败轨迹修改结构。在图构建对照实验中，从零在线演化使 HotpotQA 答案 EM 从 58.8 升至 66.3，F1 从 71.21 升至 78.79；修改需通过留出验证集才会保留。
papers.key_insight: 对社区复杂搜索，可将意图澄清、证据检索、交叉核对与回答生成组织成可编辑过程图。最值得借鉴的是局部导航和验证后更新：避免把整套流程一次塞进上下文，并用失败查询回放检验修改。原文也发现错误专家先验会明显降低成功率，增加指导调用还会产生额外 token 成本。

papers.title: Environments as Scaffold: Enriching Feedback to Bootstrap Self-Evolving Agents in Long-Horizon Tasks
papers.authors: Hongbang Yuan, Zhuoran Jin, Yixin Cao
papers.abstract: Large Language Models demonstrate remarkable proficiency in static reasoning, yet training them as autonomous agents through Reinforcement Learning (RL) for long-horizon tasks is often hindered by severe reward sparsity. While conventional agent-side warming up via supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can alleviate this, it is frequently limited by data scarcity and constrained exploration. To address this, we propose a paradigm shift to environment-side adaptation by constructing Feedback-Enriched Environments (FEEs). Through a pilot study, we establish a feedback design strategy that reformulates environments by transitioning from action guidance to observation enrichment during the later stages of both intra-episode exploration and inter-episode evolution. Large-scale experiments on SciWorld and BFCL benchmarks using various Qwen3 model scales and RL algorithms such as GRPO, GSPO, and DAPO demonstrate that FEEs consistently yield performance improvements over standard settings. Furthermore,
papers.summary: 论文通过改造训练环境缓解长程 Agent 的稀疏奖励：前期提供行动提示，后期丰富工具观察，并逐渐让策略内化这些信息。Qwen3-4B 配合 DAPO 时，BFCL 与 SciWorld 的平均分从 43.88 升至 47.81；Qwen3-8B 配合 GSPO 时从 41.78 升至 46.39，但部分子任务出现退步。
papers.key_insight: 训练社区搜索 Agent 时，可先帮助它识别合法检索动作，再提供命中状态、证据缺口等可验证反馈，最后在无提示环境测试迁移。原文强调同组样本反馈的一致性，否则会干扰相对优势估计。应同时监控任务成功率、搜索次数和长上下文退化，避免只根据平均收益扩大上线范围。

papers.title: Explore Before Committing: Hypothesis-Guided Search for Deep Research Agents
papers.authors: Ruochen Zhou, Zhengyu Chen, Luan Zhang, Siyang Gao, Yee Whye Teh, Shiqi Chen
papers.abstract: HypoSearch explores bounded hypothesis branches before commitment. Across four benchmarks and three models, Qwen3.5-122B improves from 46.7 to 60.0 on BC-small.
papers.summary: 深度搜索容易过早选定一个看似合理的方向，后续调用不断强化最初判断。HypoSearch 先生成轻量假设，在受限分支中分别找证据，再比较各分支后作答；在 4 个基准、3 个骨干模型上评估，Qwen3.5-122B 的 BC-small 得分从 46.7 升至 60.0，工具调用少于 5 条独立轨迹。
papers.key_insight: 社区 UGC 搜索常有同名实体、隐含条件和多个可能意图，可先保留少量竞争性解释，再以帖子证据决定方向。试验时应固定总检索预算，同时记录分支覆盖、无效调用和最终答案准确率；论文结果支持推迟承诺，但不能直接换算成社区搜索的 nDCG 或 CTR 收益。

papers.title: Audit Without Verification: When LLM Accountability Layers Relay Rather Than Check
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.07680v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Multi-agent LLM pipelines increasingly span organisational boundaries; when a fault surfaces, someone must determine where it entered. The artifact available is rarely a full execution trace: it is the reports each agent filed, and a filed report can state a conclusion alongside its observations. Using a pre-registered, institutionally partitioned pipeline of six agents with process-level information boundaries, balanced defect injection and matched clean twins (345,600 requests per chain model, two models), we first report that our pre-registered hypothesis -- that collective responsibility framing degrades escalation with chain length -- is not supported.
  The layer nevertheless fails asymmetrically. It originates almost nothing: zero allegations across 7,996 clean episodes where every agent stayed silent. It filters upstream error poorly, naming an innocent party in 34.4% and 62.6% of clean episodes where an agent raised a false alar
papers.summary: 研究在六智能体流水线中注入缺陷，检验审计层能否独立定位问题。上游没有指出真实来源的子集中，审计者仅凭报告的定位准确率为 4.1%，读取同批原始记录则为 60.3%；移除报告中的结论字段后升至 45.2%。原先关于责任表述随链长影响升级行为的预注册假设未获支持。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索的多 Agent 核验应保留原始帖子、工具输出和时间戳，避免裁判只复述检索 Agent 的结论。可分别传递观察与推断，盲测裁判在错误候选集合下能否恢复真实证据。移除结论会损失正确提示的价值，因此应分层报告误导与正确提示条件下的准确率，不能只看整体均值。

papers.title: RuleMem: Active Rule Memory for Long-Term Conversational Agents
papers.authors: Xingyuan Zeng, Zuohan Wu, Quanming Yao, Yue Wang, Wei Liu, Libin Zheng, Jiuke Wang, Jian Yin
papers.abstract: Natural-language Horn clauses and Rule Perplexity Consistency guide evidence retrieval. LoCoMo accuracy exceeds the average of 14 baselines by 27.47 points; also evaluated on LongMemEval_s*.
papers.summary: RuleMem 从历史对话归纳自然语言 Horn 规则，并用规则困惑度一致性机制校验，让记忆主动指导证据检索与推理。在 LoCoMo 的 14 个基线对比中，其准确率超过基线平均值 27.47 个百分点，相对提升 54.3%；论文还在 LongMemEval_s* 上检验长程对话问答。
papers.key_insight: 可将社区多轮问答中反复出现的条件关系整理成规则，用于召回语义距离较远但逻辑相关的帖子。关键是将规则与原始证据绑定，并对时间变化、反例和规则冲突做验证。论文的 54.3% 是相对基线平均值的提升，不能解读为相对最强系统；业务验证仍应回到相关性与答案可靠性。

papers.title: EdgeMem: LLM-Free Agent Memory Construction and Retrieval via Evidence-Preserving Multi-Anchor Hypergraph
papers.authors: Zeyang Cui, Jiannong Cao, Zhiyuan Wen, Bo Yuan, Junlan Feng, Shengyuan Chen
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.05553v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Agent memory allows LLM agents to use earlier interactions when answering new queries. Existing methods often compress interaction histories into summaries or other LLM-generated representations. Repeated generation adds cost and can discard answer-bearing details before the system knows what a future query will require. We propose EdgeMem, an agent-memory method built around a simple principle: preserve original interaction turns and organize them through complementary content, temporal, and episodic cues. EdgeMem realizes this principle with a multi-anchor hypergraph constructed by lightweight local processing. Retrieval directly returns source evidence and reserves LLM use for final answer generation, combining structured access to multi-session histories with faithful retention of the original conversation. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S show strong retrieval and memory-grounded question answering; on LoCoMo, EdgeMem achie
papers.summary: EdgeMem 针对智能体记忆摘要丢失细节和生成成本高的问题，用内容、时间与事件锚点构建超图，直接检索原始对话轮次。记忆构建和检索均不调用生成式大模型；在统一提示的 7 个复现系统中，LoCoMo 严格裁判得分为 61.01，高于最强对照的 58.70，并在 LongMemEval-S 验证。
papers.key_insight: 社区帖子和评论往往信息短碎、时间关系强，可保留原文并用实体与时间锚点连接多轮证据，降低反复摘要造成的信息损失。适合先验证追问场景的证据召回与回答可追溯性。公开仓库仍是与论文差异较大的早期实现，当前版本尚待同步，因此落地需要自行补齐实现和复现。

papers.title: NeoHorse-1: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement via Agentic Post-Training with Routing Harness
papers.authors: NeoHorse Team, Guoliang Cao, Guohao Dai, Tianyu Guo, Kai Han
papers.abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) requires a concrete mechanism through which an AI system observes its capabilities and converts that evidence into the next round of learning. We present NeoHorse-1, a family of agent-native models developed to explore this path through agentic post-training. Our system combines a heterogeneous model pool with intelligent routing, recording the predicted capability demand, selected service tier, and subsequent interaction for each user turn. These records are converted into training examples that preserve interleaved reasoning, tool calls, and harness context, and are admitted through structural validation, six-dimensional semantic evaluation, and subscene-level labeling. Routing signals organize supervised fine-tuning into a three-stage curriculum and extend to routing-guided on-policy distillation, where a teacher supervises student-generated responses under the same progression. Capability-guided allocation then converts evaluation feedback into the
papers.summary: NeoHorse-1 将模型路由记录转化为训练课程，保留推理、工具调用与执行环境，经结构和六维语义检查后开展三阶段训练及在线策略蒸馏。4B 模型的十项评测平均分从 Qwen3.5-4B 的 58.94 升至 64.87；9B 从 65.60 升至 69.04，收益主要集中于多步交互和执行反馈任务。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索系统可记录查询难度、路由层级、检索轨迹和失败类型，再据此分配轻量与高能力模型的训练样本。其启示是让调度日志成为能力诊断数据，而不是只保存最终回答。不同模型的指令遵循并非全面提升，迁移时应保留独立测试集，单独核对引用正确率、工具成功率和每次查询成本。

papers.authors: Yang Li, Sergey Volkov, Hai Liu, Zongsi Xu, Xiyu Chen, Tuo Zhou, Dian Shao, Hao Sun, Ye Lu
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.08472v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Agentic systems persist model-visible memory while mutating workspaces, while a runtime, registry, or approval service may hold authority state outside both. Identical final files can then require opposite safe actions. We call this the cross-substrate authority gap: decision- relevant authorization information resides outside the planner-visible workspace or memory state. Across two controlled mini-benchmark families, three experiments compare planner-observation augmentation with an execution-time authority check using real Git lineage, durably recorded agent execution attempts, deterministic oracles, and two model routes. Experiment 1 is a 128-cell controlled evidence ablation: authority-blind candidate evidence obtains 0/32 final semantic success, while raw receipts and a typed relation both obtain 32/32. company: Jiangxi Science and Technology Normal University
papers.summary: 论文指出，文件内容相同并不代表执行者拥有相同权限，授权信息可能位于智能体观察之外。128 单元的消融中，无授权证据为 0/32 成功，加入原始回执或类型化关系均为 32/32；重放 32 个固定动作时，确定性执行检查拦住全部 6 个不安全意图，并放行 12 个合法发布意图。

papers.title: CAPMAS: Capability-Based Delegation of Privileges in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.authors: Rasmus Moorits Veski, Rachid Guerraoui, David Froelicher
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.06500v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Agentic systems require secure and efficient delegation of privileges across multiple collaborating agents. Existing approaches fall into two categories. Some propagate user identities directly to agents, obscuring accountability and creating persistent over-privilege risks that are amplified by the non-deterministic behaviour of AI agents. Others rely on continuous synchronization with a central Identity and Access Management (IAM) provider, introducing additional latency and communication overhead.
  We present CAPMAS, a novel architecture for secure end-to-end query execution in multi-agent systems. CAPMAS newly combines a contrastive learning-based semantic scoping pipeline that maps natural-language queries to bounded privilege sets before execution with expressive Macaroon-based tokens that enable offline, tamper-evident delegation with monotonic privilege reduction across agents. By decoupling authentication and delegation enforce
papers.summary: CAPMAS 用对比学习把自然语言请求映射为有限权限，再以 Macaroon 令牌在多智能体间逐步收缩授权范围，减少集中身份服务通信。在常见委托深度不超过 10 时，令牌生成与本地收缩比两种签名基线快逾 10 倍；根权限约 193 字节，每次追加限制约 119 字节。
papers.key_insight: 社区 Agent 的跨工具检索可把用户可访问的群组、时间范围与操作类型编入可收缩授权，而不是把完整用户身份一路传下去。语义范围识别仍可能漏判，需结合显式权限校验并测试过度授权与误拒绝。论文性能数字来自授权微基准，不能当作整个搜索请求的加速倍数。

papers.title: Omni Interaction Agent Technical Report
papers.authors: Orantqing, Shengpeng Ji, Junlong Tong, Jialong Zuo, Dongjie Fu
papers.abstract: In this work, we present Gander, an end-to-end model that unifies omni perception, realtime interaction, and agentic capabilities within a single framework. In contrast to turn-based conventional paradigms, Gander continuously receives streaming inputs across multiple modalities, including video, speech, and text, enabling natural full-duplex interaction in both everyday conversations and complex workflow-oriented agent scenarios. Users can interrupt the model at any time, while the model can also proactively provide intermediate feedback or ask follow up questions. To natively support these capabilities, Gander adopts two key architectural designs: 1) It employs a Cerebellum-Brain collaborative framework, in which the Cerebellum is responsible for realtime interaction and omni conversational capabilities, while the Brain handles complex reasoning and higher-level agentic tasks. The two components interact continuously through tool calling and the agent orchestration runtime. 2) The Ce
papers.summary: 腾讯 Gander 用前端“小脑”处理流式音视频交互，后端“大脑”执行长程推理与工具任务，并通过运行时同步状态。在 Full-Duplex-Bench v3 的 100 个场景中，适时接话率达 100%、打断率为 8.0%；但端到端 Pass@1 为 0.400，低于 GPT-Realtime 的 0.600。
